Overview

Dortmund is a city in North Rhine-Westphalia with a population of 588,000. A former industrial powerhouse turned green tech and innovation hub, home to Borussia Dortmund and a thriving cultural scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
